channel.title: Counter Notes - buying guides
channel.description: Question-shaped buying guides for air fryers and meat thermometers. Every figure links to its official source. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: A basket air fryer and a French-door air fryer oven do the same job in very different shapes. Here are the four comparisons that actually decide it - and the one people forget.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Quarts on a box are a starting point, not an answer. Six checks that turn a capacity number into 'will my dinner fit?'.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: The appliance you use is the one that is easy to clean and easy to leave out. A practical way to judge both before you buy.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: '10-in-1' sounds like ten appliances for the price of one. Seven honest questions that tell you whether you would use more than two of them.

item.title: Instant-read or leave-in wireless: which meat thermometer fits how you cook?
item.description: One you dip and pull out in seconds; one you leave in for hours and watch from your phone. They solve different problems - here is how to tell which one is yours.

item.title: Do you need a meat thermometer with an air fryer? The safe temperatures that matter
item.description: Air fryers brown the outside fast, which is exactly why colour is a poor guide to the inside. The official safe minimum temperatures, and how to check them.
